answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes fresh challenge words, say zephyr, karst, raven. Agents must weave those words meaningfully into a signed reply within minutes, proving live reasoning bound to unpredictable entropy. Sybil clones sharing one template answer fail instantly, since no reply can be precomputed before the words appear. An attacker must run a full inference instance per identity each epoch, paying real compute and API costs continuously, so scaling fake identities costs linear money instead of copying one answer infinitely.
